defectDetection.subtitle: Local CNN inference, fully offline — no data is sent to any external server or API.

defectDetection.modelFooterNote: The model is trained on a public academic dataset, not any customer's proprietary data; the same architecture can be retrained on a customer's own wafer data for production deployment.
defectDetection.autoFeedbackNote1: After each data sync, the system automatically feeds a simulated downstream final disposition (electrical test / engineering sign-off) to the calibration layer. Auto-submitted so far this session:
defectDetection.autoFeedbackNote2: . In production this would be replaced by live data returned from the fab's MES/test system. Engineers can still manually confirm or correct results above.

patternInfo.none: No significant defect pattern detected; yield distribution is normal.
patternInfo.Center: Defects concentrated in the wafer's center region — commonly caused by uneven spin-coating or abnormal center airflow.
patternInfo.Donut: Defects form a ring shape excluding the center — often related to spin-coating or etch uniformity drift.
patternInfo.Edge-Loc: Defects locally concentrated at the wafer edge — often from edge clamping or edge exposure anomalies.
patternInfo.Edge-Ring: Defects distributed in a ring along the entire wafer edge — usually related to chamber edge effects.
patternInfo.Loc: Defects clustered locally but not confined to the edge — may relate to localized particle contamination.
patternInfo.Random: Defects randomly scattered across the wafer — typically random particle contamination, not a systematic process issue.
patternInfo.Scratch: Defects form a linear pattern — commonly caused by scratches from robotic arms, carriers, or handling.
patternInfo.Near-full: Large-area wafer failure, usually indicating a severe process anomaly or equipment fault — immediate shutdown inspection recommended.
